findings.title: SFC circular on Haiti and Yemen sanctions amendments

rendered_html: 📔 Regulatory Bulletin — 14 September 2026 (Daily) Executive Summary • 🟡 SFC circular reports that Haiti and Yemen UN sanctions-amendment regulations were gazetted on 11 September with immediate effect. The underlying regulations apply within their legal scope; the circular targets the SFC’s licensed perimeter. Hong Kong 🟡 SFC circular on Haiti and Yemen sanctions amendments 🇭🇰 Item ID: item-20260911-sfc-aml-circulars-26ec57 ⏰ Deadline: Immediate effect from 2026-09-11 Products: Investment, payments, digital On 11 September, SFC circular SFO/IS/037/2026 stated that the Haiti and Yemen amendment regulations were gazetted with immediate effect. The Haiti amendment renews travel and financial sanctions and revises arms-embargo requirements, while the Yemen amendment renews financial sanctions and a travel ban. The SFC reminds licensed corporations, SFC-licensed virtual-asset service providers and associated entities to use Chapter 6 of its AML/CFT Guideline for appropriate compliance measures. The underlying regulations are required within their legal scope; the circular does not state a new obligation for authorised institutions generally. Source: SFC Circular SFO/IS/037/2026 SG/UK/GLOBAL Benchmark Comparable overseas developments and commercial/control benchmarks. They do not establish Hong Kong requirements. Watch List • 🟢 Monitor the linked Gazette instruments for operational detail and entity-applicability. The circular states no transition, reporting date or prescribed system design.
